messages:
Jules Harper: hey team — need to add my spouse to benefits. he just moved in with me (2/10) and we're still waiting on his SSN (applied, ETA ~6 weeks). can i add him now? also worried about HSA eligibility since he has an employer that offered an HDHP but he might not enroll. what proofs do you need?

Mina Li (People Ops): you can start the add without SSN, but we need the SSN within 60 days for payroll/records. since this is a midyear change (QLE), coverage can be effective as of the QLE date (2/10) if docs are submitted within 30 days of the QLE. any reason the SSN will be delayed more than 60 days?

Jules Harper: no, just normal processing delays overseas. hoping 6 weeks. can we accept visa docs or SSA receipt in the meantime?

Mina Li (People Ops): yes — if SSN not ready, upload visa + I-94 and SSA application receipt. we'll mark it provisional and follow up once SSN arrives. final confirmation happens after we get SSN.

Alex K (Benefits): on HSA: if your spouse actually enrolls in another employer's HDHP, then you are not HSA-eligible for family contributions. we need an employer coverage letter or signed declination from their employer to verify. if it's unclear now, you can still enroll in medical; we'll flag HSA eligibility and reconcile with payroll if needed.

Jules Harper: got it. will adding mid-month cause payroll proration? will premiums be charged retro to 2/10 automatically?

Payroll - Priya: premiums prorate to the effective date. so if effective date = 2/10, you'll see payroll adjustment on next run. example internal rule: premium_change_effective_date = QLE_date (no retro beyond QLE unless exception). if you need true retro to 2/1 we'd have to escalate and approve an exception.

Jules Harper: can you drop the exact docs checklist here so i can upload?

Mina Li (People Ops): checklist to upload:
- PDF: marriage certificate
- PDF: proof of joint residence dated within 60 days (lease, utility, bank stmt)
- PDF: spouse visa and I-94 (if SSN pending)
- PDF: SSA receipt or SSN when available
- PDF: employer coverage letter for spouse (if HSA concerns)
Upload here: https://app.redwood.com/benefits/upload (select "Add Dependent - QLE")

Jules Harper: thanks. if i upload visa + SSA receipt but SSN comes after 60 days, what happens?

Mina Li (People Ops): if SSN arrives after 60 days we'll contact you. in some cases HR may need to cancel retro coverage and re-enroll starting when SSN provided — rare but possible. try to upload the SSA receipt asap.

Alex K (Benefits): also note — if later it's found spouse enrolled in an HDHP elsewhere, we might need to adjust HSA contributions retroactively and correct payroll with a deduction/credit. we'll coordinate with payroll on any retro corrections.

Jules Harper: one last q — do i need to update 401k beneficiary when i add spouse? or is that separate?

People Ops Bot: FYI — 401k beneficiary updates are managed separately via the retirement portal. update at https://app.redwood.com/retirement if you want to change beneficiaries within 30 days.

Jules Harper: ok i'll upload docs today and ping @Mina when done. thanks all :thumbsup:

Mina Li (People Ops): thanks — once you upload we'll start review. if anything missing we'll DM you.
